title: settings
subtitle: who you are, what signs for you and who may write with you

members.title: members and agents
members.writersEmpty: your key has not published a writers list — the gateway lets you write based on what the write gate sees
members.agentsEmpty: no agents — nobody can write on your behalf
members.fallback: no list — so far we only see the write-gate decision above.
